This blueprint is one ranked option for El Dorado, labeled MYTHOLOGICAL throughout: El Dorado is a legend, not an established historical city, and no part of this record claims that a golden city has been found. The real goldwork of the Muisca peoples is stated separately from the legend wherever they differ.

The ranking follows the pair method: source-faithfulness first, then level-fit, feasibility, buildability, completeness at the same level, and testability. The technology level is stated on the record, and a higher-level outcome is never presented as available at a lower level.

Technology level

Technology level L1. Available now: buildable or representable with existing tools, materials, and data.

Feasibility label

demonstrated

Layout

A complete digital model of the El Dorado legend: the lake ceremony, the golden temple district, and the city of Manoa as told in the stories, with legend, archaeology, and interpretation marked on separate layers.

Dimensions

Lake model 3.0 km across; temple district 400 m by 300 m; Manoa city plan 2.0 km by 1.5 km; raft ceremony route 800 m across the lake.

Walls and gates

Digital walls and gates: a temple precinct wall with a lake gate and a land gate, and a city wall with four gates, all modeled as interpretation, not excavation.

Districts

  • Lake ceremony waters: the raft route, the offering place, and the shore stations
  • Golden temple district: temple, workshops, and treasure rooms as interpretation
  • Manoa city quarters: housing, markets, and civic halls of the legendary city
  • Shore and raft yards: boat building, raft making, and ceremony preparation
  • Mountain approaches: roads, lookout stations, and the route into the valley

Ecosystems

  • Lake water and shore reeds
  • mountain forest and cloud forest
  • valley farmland
  • the high mountain sky

Caves / Underground

Caves and underground: the digital twin's underground is modeled explicitly, not omitted: temple vault layers, cistern and drain layers, and a labeled survey layer for mountain caves and rock shelters near the lake, marked as surveyed natural features where they exist and as interpretation where they do not. No golden cave is claimed.

Materials

Digital materials only at this level: gold-colored temple cladding as interpretation, stone, timber, and reed textures, each labeled as interpretation.

Lighting and power

Lighting and power: the model renders daylight, torchlight, and ceremony light as light studies; no physical power system is claimed at this level.

Scale treatment

Scale treatment: full legend at digital scale, 1:1 in the model, with a printable 1:5000 site plan. No physical building is claimed.

Acceptance tests

  • The model's layers separate legend, archaeology, and interpretation without mixing them.
  • Every district, ecosystem, and underground layer renders and is labeled.
  • No figure is presented as a found golden city.

Signature design note: this Signature edition record is a Signature-original blueprint variant of the same ranked option. It is labeled where speculative and is never presented as an authentic public record.

demo.code:
RADII = [200.0, 450.0, 800.0, 1500.0]
print("Ring plan: Digital Twin of El Dorado")
import math
prev = 0.0
for i, r in enumerate(RADII, 1):
    print("Ring %d radius %.0f m, circumference %.0f m, ring area %.0f sq m" % (i, r, 2 * math.pi * r, math.pi * (r * r - prev * prev)))
    prev = r
print("Outer diameter: %.0f m" % (2 * RADII[-1]))

Outer diameter: 3000 m

body:
This blueprint is one ranked option for El Dorado, labeled MYTHOLOGICAL throughout: El Dorado is a legend, not an established historical city, and no part of this record claims that a golden city has been found. The real goldwork of the Muisca peoples is stated separately from the legend wherever they differ.

The ranking follows the pair method: source-faithfulness first, then level-fit, feasibility, buildability, completeness at the same level, and testability. The technology level is stated on the record, and a higher-level outcome is never presented as available at a lower level.

Rank

Rank 16 of 16.

Ranking scores (round 2, final)

  • source-faithfulness: 9/10
  • level-fit: 5/10
  • engineering feasibility: 4/10
  • buildability at stated scale: 4/10
  • completeness at its level: 10/10
  • testability: 5/10
  • Total: 37/60

Technology level

Technology level L4. Future frontier: requires future technology generations.

Feasibility label

not-established

Layout

The fullest future outcome: a living city that matches the El Dorado legend at full scale and full population, with the lake ceremony, the golden temple, and the city of Manoa all inhabited. This is the Level 4 endpoint of the path, labeled not-established, and it ranks last among the shipped options because feasibility and buildability at this scale are the lowest, however complete the vision.

Dimensions

City area 300 hectares; plain and valley 12.0 km by 8.0 km; population in the plan 110,000; temple 80 m by 50 m.

Walls and gates

Walls and gates: full city walls with lake, mountain, and land gates, harbor and river gates, and plain boundary gates at every canal crossing.

Districts

  • Temple and palace island: the temple and palace as living civic buildings
  • Lake city neighborhoods: homes, schools, and workshops by the lake
  • River-port city: the port, docks, and trade city
  • Valley farm cities: farm towns across the valley
  • Assembly and festival grounds: the great gathering grounds of the legend, as interpretation

Ecosystems

  • Lake water and shore wetlands
  • river water and banks
  • valley farmland and forest
  • mountain sky and weather

Caves / Underground

Caves and underground: the living city's underground is explicit: a complete undercity of transit, service, cistern, and archive levels beneath the city, plus designed grotto halls under the temple, labeled as designed. No ancient golden cave city is claimed, and no lower level claims this undercity.

Materials

Materials: stone, concrete, timber, and future materials as specified at build time; no future material is claimed as available today.

Lighting and power

Lighting and power: city power 115 MW from solar, hydro, storage, and interconnection. Full closure is future work and is labeled as such.

Scale treatment

Scale treatment: living full-scale city at Level 4 only. Never presented as available at Levels 1 to 3.

Acceptance tests

  • City water, power, and food close for 365 days in simulation before any residency claim.
  • All city gates operate in a full drill.
  • All districts, ecosystems, and undercity levels are built and labeled.

Signature design note: this Signature edition record is a Signature-original blueprint variant of the same ranked option. It is labeled where speculative and is never presented as an authentic public record.
